name: calculate-carbon-tax-south-africa
description: Calculate South African carbon tax from emissions and the entity's allowance, check scope, and estimate the carbon fuel levy embedded in fleet fuel spend.
requires_human_steps: License emissions facilities with SARS (administered through customs and excise)
Confirm the entity's tax-free allowance determination (basic, trade exposure, performance, carbon budget, offsets) with a registered tax practitioner
Source emissions tonnage from formal GHG reporting by a competent person
rule_basis: Carbon Tax Act (2019): R308/t CO2e from 1 Jan 2026, R236/t for 2025 (National Treasury Budget 2026 Review); allowances 60%-95% per SARS (entity-specific, taken as input); carbon fuel levy 19c/l petrol, 23c/l diesel from 1 Apr 2026
